context_requirements: Functional muscarinic or nicotinic acetylcholine receptors (CHRM1-4, CHRNA7) expressed on the cell surface
Intact Gq/PLC/PKC or cAMP signaling downstream of the receptor
Proliferative or survival signaling that is sensitive to cholinergic modulation
falsifiers: No change in any of the proximal immediate-early genes (FOS, EGR1, JUN, IER3) at 6 h in any cell line
No reduction in proliferation-associated genes or no increase in CDKN1A at 24 h in any cell line
Uniform absence of transcriptional response across all nine cell lines

evidence.supports: Muscarinic M3 receptor is expressed in SCLC and cholinergic receptor agonist acetylcholine modulates integrin expression and adhesion, while M3 antagonist inhibits proliferation and promotes apoptosis.

changes: Removed PMID 16183168 from evidence because its abstract explicitly states carbachol had no effect on Bim transcription, so it does not support a transcriptional down-regulation claim.
Kept PMID 27009814 because it directly supports cholinergic modulation of integrin expression/adhesion and M3R-dependent proliferation/apoptosis in a cancer cell line.
